phases.goal: Grasp the soap while leaving the toycar as the reference.
phases.name: grasp_soap

phases.goal: Transport and release the soap on the toycar's right side.
phases.name: place_right_of_toycar
phases.verify: Soap is stably right of the toycar.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: Soap is the moved object; toycar is the reference.

task_language: Ensure the dark brown hand-sized soap is placed on the right of the bright sleek toycar.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 2:move_to(arm=right,gripper=keep,orientation=keep); 3:move_to(arm=right,gripper=keep,orientation=keep); 4:release(arm=right). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Avoid releasing the soap short of the requested side; verify the held soap is stably right of the toycar before retreating.
